sources.title: Subscription Sources
sources.user_agent_recommendation: Some subscription services check User-Agent. Recommended: clash.meta.
sources.delete_confirm: Delete this source? Related nodes will also be removed.
sources.name_auto_placeholder: Leave empty to use the subscription domain
sources.empty_description: Paste one or more subscription URLs; UniConf will refresh them, parse nodes, and generate the default config automatically
sources.quick_hint_title: Only the subscription URL is required
sources.quick_hint_text: After saving, UniConf refreshes the source immediately, detects nodes, generates node groups, enables default routing policies, and prepares export config. Name, format, User-Agent, and other fields can stay empty.

groups.title: Policy Templates
groups.description: Choose a routing template, then add business routing groups only when needed. PROXY / DIRECT / REJECT are always built in and default rules are linked automatically.
groups.template_meta: Templates only decide which extra business routing groups are enabled. PROXY / DIRECT / REJECT and node selection remain available.
groups.foundation_meta: Always present. Rules can target PROXY / DIRECT / REJECT directly, while business routing groups include foundations and node outlets automatically.
groups.foundation_rule_targets_desc: Rules can target these directly for default proxy, direct, and reject traffic.
groups.global_node_outlets_desc: Outlet candidates inside business routing groups, not direct rule targets.
groups.empty_description: Default policy templates are generated automatically. Add only extra business routing groups here.
groups.auto_members_text: After saving, the system automatically includes PROXY, DIRECT, REJECT, all nodes, node selection, auto selection, fallback, and currently available country / tag node groups. Global node outlets use the default usable node pool, which excludes high-multiplier nodes by default.
groups.foundation_proxy_desc: Default proxy outlet. It aggregates rule foundations, the default usable node-pool outlets, and available node groups.
groups.foundation_direct_desc: Direct outlet. Domestic rules, LAN traffic, and traffic that should not use a proxy target this policy.
groups.foundation_reject_desc: Reject outlet. Ad, HTTPDNS, and blocking rules target this policy.
groups.foundation_all_nodes_desc: Contains the default usable node pool and excludes high-multiplier nodes by default.
groups.foundation_node_select_desc: Manually select a specific node or node group from the default usable node pool.
groups.foundation_auto_select_desc: Automatically chooses the lowest-latency node from the default usable node pool.
groups.foundation_fallback_desc: Falls back to another node from the default usable node pool when the current one fails.
groups.routing_proxy_summary: Default proxy outlet. It aggregates rule foundations, global node outlets, and available node groups.
groups.routing_group_summary: Automatically includes foundation outlets, global node outlets, and available node groups.
groups.reorder_hint: Choose a policy template; foundation outlets and node group candidates are maintained automatically

rules.title: Manual Traffic Rules
rules.reorder_hint: Default routing comes from routing policies; keep only manually added rules here, ordered by priority

export.title: Config Export
export.reset_token_confirm: Reset subscription token? All existing subscriptions using the old token will be invalidated.

preview.title: Config Preview
preview.ready_desc: The preview has no issues that need attention and can be copied or downloaded.
preview.warning_summary: {{unsupported}} blocking issues, {{partial}} automatic adjustments, and {{convert}} conversion notes found.

settings.title: Settings
settings.clear_confirm: Clear all data? This action cannot be undone.
settings.import_confirm: Confirm import? This will overwrite all current data.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Paste subscription URLs and UniConf will generate node groups, routing policies, DNS, and export config automatically
dashboard.quick_export_desc: Choose a client, then copy its subscription link or download the config. Each link includes enabled nodes, node groups, routing policies, and compatible rule sets.
dashboard.template_desc: Choose a default routing template. Foundation proxy, direct, reject, and node-selection outlets always stay enabled.
dashboard.no_data: Paste one or more subscription URLs; node groups, routing policies, rules, and export config are prepared automatically
dashboard.no_usable_nodes: There are no exportable nodes yet. Add or replace a subscription URL to continue.
dashboard.step1_desc: Paste airport or self-hosted subscription URLs, one per line
dashboard.step2_desc: Detect nodes, generate node groups, and enable default routing policies automatically
dashboard.step3_desc: Copy a client-specific subscription link on the dashboard, or use Export for advanced changes
